description: Defragmentation relocates main-cache storage but not the draft cache sharing its physical page indices.
trigger: Draft decoding is enabled, a qualifying defragmentation moves valid cached pages, and a later job reuses those pages.
expected_behavior: Relocate both caches consistently, or invalidate draft-cache reuse.
actual_behavior: defrag enumerates only self.cache tensors, then changes shared page_index metadata. Draft prefill and generation use block tables derived from those new indices against unmoved draft storage. Existing partial-prefix copying explicitly handles both caches, unlike defrag.

verification.description: Compared main-only tensor enumeration with draft block-table consumers and dual-cache prefix copying. Defrag callers are queue clearing, cancellation and completed-job cleanup.
verification.limits: No speculative generation was run; downstream output effects are unmeasured.
